requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-7286--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3459-4481-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Heavy Arbalest by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers twice.
Resolve the first Battered Golem trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Battered Golem by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the second Battered Golem trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

997-2946-4871-4976.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2946-4871-4976.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-803-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-803-6798.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.

When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

874-2866-4779-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1003-3967-5220-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-5434-5555-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2034-5434-5555-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2034-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 3.

628-3108-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.
628-3108-5147.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

3490-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2011-4050-6525.description:
Declare the creature that has Infantry Shield attached as an attacker, triggering its ability, creating a number of 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking equal to the creature's power.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Warriors, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
2011-4050-6525.notes: If Hellkite Charger has power 7 or greater, you can attach Infantry Shield to it. Just ensure to resolve the token creation ability first.

1309-3821-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
1309-3821-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Salvager of Secrets and Peregrine Drake, targeting Salvager of Secrets
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Salvager of Secrets and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

When Scurry Oak enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Kudo, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Kudo, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 3.

1863-3946-5447.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1469-3790.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Court of Vantress on the battlefield as a copy of Mystic Barrier if you aren't the monarch.
1469-3790.description:
At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, Mystic Barrier and Court of Vantress triggers twice if you aren't the monarch, or once otherwise.
Resolve the Mystic Barrier trigger, choosing "left".
If you aren't the monarch, resolve the Court of Vantress triggers, causing you to choose "right" and choosing to keep it as a copy of Mystic Barrier.
Otherwise, resolve the Court of Vantress trigger, creating a token copy of Mystic Barrier, choosing "right" as the copy enters the battlefield.
As long as there are three or more players in the game, creatures cannot attack.

731-830-1819.notablePrerequisites:
Corrupted Conscience attached to Syr Konrad.
You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.

Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Said without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Said, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2471-2834-4763.description:

Zabaz dies, triggering its modular ability and Koll.
Resolve the Zabaz trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Zabaz from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Zabaz by paying {1}.
Zabaz enters the battlefield, triggering Hero's Blade, attaching Hero's Blade to Zabaz.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
